title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount | Solid Brass Hardware | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount
description:
Clear counter clutter and keep everyday essentials organized with a space-saving, wall-mounted glass shelf designed for modern bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Get three levels of storage at the vanity with a triple tier glass shelf design
- Count on durable support with solid brass hardware and 3/8-inch thick tempered glass
- Maintain a clean, minimalist look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Coordinate your space with modern bathroom hardware made to pair with contemporary bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Glass size: 16 x 5 inches
- Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 15 inches H
- Glass thickness: 0.38 inch (3/8-inch)
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
- Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw installation (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Finish options: available in multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
